name: unbound
description: 验证、递归、缓存型 DNS 解析器，可作为本地 DNS 服务运行，支持 DNSSEC 验证、转发、缓存以及 DoT/DoH/DoQ 加密传输。

options.description: Show this help.
Config file to read instead of the default one; the file format is described in unbound.conf(5).
Do not fork into the background.
Do not create a pidfile.
Verbose; repeat to increase verbosity.
Show version number and build options.

name: unbound-checkconf
description: 检查 unbound 配置文件的语法与取值是否正确，也可用于读取某个配置项的生效值。

options.description: Config file to check; if omitted the default config file is used.
Print the value of the given option to stdout.
Output full pathname with chroot applied, e.g. with -o pidfile.
Quiet; suppress output on success.
Show this usage help.

name: unbound-host
description: DNS 查询工具，可查询主机名对应的 IPv4/IPv6 地址与邮件记录，支持 DNSSEC 验证并显示安全状态。
syntax: unbound-host [-C configfile] [-vdhr46] [-c class] [-t type] [-y key] [-f keyfile] [-F namedkeyfile] hostname

options.description: What resource record type to look for, e.g. A, AAAA, MX, TXT, NS.
What class to look for, if not class IN.
Specify a trust anchor, DS or DNSKEY, e.g. -y 'example.com DS 31560 5 1 1CFED8478...'.
Enable DNSSEC using the default root anchor.
Read trust anchors from file, with lines in the same format as -y.
Read named.conf-style trust anchors from file.
Use the specified unbound.conf (none is read by default).
Read forwarder information from /etc/resolv.conf; breaks validation if the forwarder does not do DNSSEC.
Be more verbose, shows nodata and security status.
Debug, traces the action; -d -d shows more.
Use the IPv4 network, avoid IPv6.
Use the IPv6 network, avoid IPv4.
Show this usage help.

name: unbound-control
description: unbound 服务的远程控制工具，可查看运行状态与统计、重载配置、增删本地数据、清理缓存等。

options.description: Config file to read; the default config file is used if omitted.
Server address to connect to; if omitted the config file is used.
Quiet; do not print anything if it works ok.
Show this usage help.
Display status of the server.
Print statistics and reset the counters.
Peek at statistics without resetting the counters.
Stop the server.
Reload the server; this flushes data, stats and the request list.
Reload the server but try to keep the RRset and message cache.
Reload with only a brief stop of server processing, keeping the cache.
Change the logging detail level at run time.
Add a new local zone.
Add local data, e.g. local_data www.example.com A 192.0.2.1.
Flush common record types for the name from the cache.
Flush everything at or under the name from the caches.
Print the cache to stdout.
Print the nameservers that would be used for the name.

name: unbound-anchor
description: DNSSEC 根信任锚的初始化与更新工具，在启动验证解析前运行，用于准备 root.key 文件。
syntax: unbound-anchor [-46lSv] [-a file] [-c file] [-u name] [-f resolv.conf] [-r root.hints] [-P port]

options.description: Root key file; it is both input and output for this tool.
Certificate file used to verify the downloaded trust anchor.
List the builtin key and cert on stdout.
Server name in the https url used to fetch the anchor.
Do not use SNI for the https connection.
Source address to bind to.
Work using IPv4 only.
Work using IPv6 only.
Use the given resolv.conf to look up the anchor.
Use the given root.hints file.
Be more verbose.
Use this port for the https connection, default 443.
